name: Virginia Championship 2026

venue.name: Henrico Sports & Events Center
venue.address: 1 All Star Boulevard, Glen Allen, VA 23059

information: This is the Virginia championship, but anyone can compete regardless of their state of residence. See more information on the Championship Eligibility tab. This event will take place on the arena side of the [Henrico Sports & Events Center](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Qa6Py33k4Pm3DHJL8). Please note that outside food and beverage is not permitted in the venue.
